text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Gaaagh! Dammit, I lost! Total defeat!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's just the result of a fair 
fight... They were simply stronger than me 
today!
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you next time!
Let's train even harder from now on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know that! There's no way I can 
accept ending it like this myself!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We gotta make today fuel for future 
victories!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If they're strong, I just gotta get 
stronger! I'll keep snapping at their 
heels until I win!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it... I'll use this frustration as 
fuel to grow stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, obviously!!! Like hell I'm 
gonna let 'em keep looking down on me like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"There are no limits to my running. I'll 
train until I drop, train and train—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I won't be satisfied unless I beat down 
every single person on this track!!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll put on a fiery clash that'll make the 
blood boil in everyone watching!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do this, Trainy!!! First off, 
full-power bunny hops all the way back 
homeee—!!"
